card_1.name: Random Selfie Card
card_1.description: Target must send a random selfie photo right now!

card_2.name: Alien Mode Card
card_2.description: For 15 minutes, target must reply to chats with weird words/typos added.

card_3.name: Send Meme Card
card_3.description: Target must send 1 random or worst meme/sticker.

card_4.name: Singing Challenge Card
card_4.description: Target must send a voice note singing a kids song.

card_5.name: Vent Freely Card
card_5.description: You can vent for 20 minutes, target can only say 'Yes, you're right'.

card_6.name: I'm The Boss Card
card_6.description: For 30 minutes, target must call you 'Sir/Ma'am' or 'Boss'.

card_7.name: Type With Nose Card
card_7.description: Target must type 'I love you so much' using their nose without correcting typos.

card_8.name: Forced Poem Card
card_8.description: For the next 5 messages (while active), reply to chat using poems/rhymes.

card_9.name: Stop Sulking Card
card_9.description: Target must immediately send a smiling photo and stop sulking right now.

card_10.name: Embarrassing Contact Name Card
card_10.description: Change target's contact name to something embarrassing for 24 hours. Must screenshot.

card_11.name: Virtual Genie Card
card_11.description: Ask target for one small favor and they cannot refuse.

card_12.name: Robot Voice Card
card_12.description: Target must reply via voice note with a robotic, stuttering voice.

card_13.name: Emoji Only Card
card_13.description: For the next 5 messages, target can only reply using emoji combinations, NO LETTERS allowed.

card_14.name: Cheesy Food Flirt Card
card_14.description: Target must give you one corny pickup line related to food.

card_15.name: Ceiling Selfie Card
card_15.description: Target must take a photo of the ceiling/sky right now and caption it poetically.

card_16.name: Missing You Spam Card
card_16.description: Target must spam 'I miss you' messages 10 times in a row right now.

card_17.name: Funny Filter Card
card_17.description: Target must send a photo/video with the weirdest Instagram or TikTok filter.

card_18.name: News Reporter Card
card_18.description: Target must send a voice note reporting like a news anchor about things in front of them.

card_19.name: No Laughing Card
card_19.description: You can joke freely, but target is forbidden from replying with laugh words (haha/lol) or emoji. Must stay serious!

card_20.name: Mind Reader Card
card_20.description: Target must guess what you're doing right now. If wrong, you can roast them.

card_21.name: Praise Me Card
card_21.description: Target must send a short paragraph with exaggerated praise in ALL CAPS.

card_22.name: Weather Report Card
card_22.description: Target must send a selfie of the current sky/weather outside their window, captioned like a weather presenter.

card_23.name: Eye Closeup Card
card_23.description: Target must take a closeup zoom photo of just one eye, send it, and not unsee it!

card_24.name: Jakarta Slang Card
card_24.description: Target must use slang language mixed with English (like, basically, literally) in every message.

card_25.name: Lip Sync Concert Card
card_25.description: Target must send a short video lip-syncing a dangdut or pop song with dramatic expression.

card_26.name: Absurd Review Card
card_26.description: Target must send a voice note reviewing a random object nearby as if it's a luxury item worth millions.

card_27.name: No 'Whatever' Card
card_27.description: Whatever you ask, target is strictly forbidden from answering 'whatever'. Must give a definite answer!

card_28.name: Professional Pickup Line Card
card_28.description: Target must give you a flirty pickup line using their profession's jargon (engineering, coding, architecture, etc).

card_29.name: Pronoun Change Card
card_29.description: Target must change their pronouns from 'I-You' to 'Me-You' or use overly dramatic formal pronouns.

card_30.name: Ridiculous Tutorial Card
card_30.description: Target must send a video tutorial on how to do something super trivial (like how to drink water correctly).

card_31.name: Mood Booster Card
card_31.description: Target must send 3 meme/motivational quotes throughout the next hour to cheer you up.

card_32.name: Guess The Doodle Card
card_32.description: You draw something badly on your phone, target must guess it and praise your 'art' like it's a masterpiece.

card_33.name: Embarrassing Story Card
card_33.description: Target must tell one funny or embarrassing childhood story via voice note.

card_34.name: Funny Nickname Card
card_34.description: You get to assign a silly nickname to target (like 'Potato', 'Brick', 'Fridge') that they MUST use to call you for 1 hour.

card_35.name: Motivator Chaos Card
card_35.description: Target must act like a self-help guru, sending a 1+ minute voice note with nonsensical life advice and motivational quotes.

card_36.name: Baby Mode Card
card_36.description: You get to be extra clingy and needy for 1 hour, target MUST pamper and agree with all your silly requests.

card_37.name: Spam Call Card
card_37.description: For the next 12 hours, you can call target anytime, say one random word, and hang up. Target can't complain!

card_38.name: Silly Contract Card
card_38.description: Target must write a goofy handwritten contract that YOU dictate (like 'I promise to praise my love forever'), sign it, take a photo, and send it. Legally binding in LDR law!

card_39.name: One Word Only Card
card_39.description: For 60 minutes, target can only reply with ONE WORD max per message. Watch them struggle trying to explain things!

card_40.name: Robotic Customer Service Card
card_40.description: For 60 minutes, target must respond like a stiff customer service representative - no romantic replies allowed!

card_42.name: Extreme Photo Challenge Card
card_42.description: Target must send 10 funny pose photos within 2 hours with funny captions.

card_43.name: Forced Romance Call Card
card_43.description: Target must listen to a 1-hour voice call, casual conversation is fine.

card_44.name: Must Listen Vent Card
card_44.description: Vent as much as you want for 90 minutes, target must listen and reply seriously.

card_45.name: Surprise Date Plan Card
card_45.description: Plan a surprise date for the next week right now, target doesn't pay but must show up.
